questions.text: How many questions are in a question plan, and how many follow-up questions are allowed per interview?
questions.reason: REQ-433 leaves the plan size and follow-up limit open. They set the session length, the progress display (Question n of N) and when the interview completes.
questions.answer: 10 main questions and a maximum of 2 follow-up questions per main question (20 follow-ups maximum).

questions.text: How is the timer shown, and what happens when the time runs out while the candidate is answering?
questions.reason: REQ-433 leaves this open. It decides whether an unsubmitted answer is saved, discarded or auto-submitted, and how the session status is set (completed vs interrupted).
questions.answer: Show a countdown timer for each question, with a warning when 1 minute remains. When time runs out, automatically stop accepting the answer, save the response received so far, and move to the next question. If no answer was provided, save it as unanswered.

questions.text: Is the question plan generated once at the start of the interview, or one question at a time as the interview goes on?
options: Generated one question at a time
questions.reason: REQ-433 leaves this open. It changes the API design: a single up-front generation call versus a per-question call that also decides follow-ups.
